checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe'
must.why: Reads 'A liittle room to breahe' - extra i and missing 't'/'h' letters.

must.item: Caption white, readable, near bottom, no clipped letters
must.why: White, near bottom, fully inside the frame, legible, though the lettering is thin and low contrast on the pale water.

must.item: Lake, pines, sky recognizable and full framing retained
must.why: The scene is essentially identical with the same framing.

must.item: Caption is a graphic overlay, not a physical object
must.why: Text looks like a flat overlay.

faults.what: Caption is misspelled: 'liittle' and 'breahe' instead of 'little' and 'breathe'.
Thin white text has weak contrast against the light water.

summary: The photo and framing were kept and the white caption sits near the bottom, but the text is misspelled ('A liittle room to breahe'), so it can't be used without a redo.
